Description: Premium rate segment resolution ignores PCOVRSGT SEQ, so a coverage referencing a segment in a non-premium slot captures that segment's QuikGps grid while the owning plan shows Values Not on File. 20 of 91 segments mis-attributed; 18 plans missing grids; 645 grid cells written by more than one segment. Largest exposure is the L10 family (~405 active policies) and GL LP85 (249 active).
Notes: Closed in v59.05. PR segments now resolve on the PCOVRSGT SEQ 1 slot and one-to-many (new resolve_all), so premium grids attach to every plan LifePRO prices them on and to no others. QuikGps 2219 to 2277 rows across 31 expected plans; 0 cross-segment cell collisions; 0 unresolved segments. Shared-rate-candidate PR rows dropped for plans owning a SEQ 1 segment, retiring the pre-fix L10 workaround that had F/BL transposed. quikplan VARGP refreshed via R7B (28 plans) so A7 and #140 pass. Controlled A/B regression with QLA_PR_SEGMENT_SLOT_OWNERSHIP=0 baseline: all non-GP rate tables unchanged. Release gate RELEASE_OK, all 24 smokes PASS including new #158 job. CV/RV/NP slot-awareness is a deliberate follow-up.
